package projectauthoring

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

type Processor struct {
	Flows       repository.ProjectAuthoringFlowRepository
	Students    domainservice.ProjectAuthoringStudentService
	TZ          domainservice.ProjectAuthoringTZService
	IDs         IDGenerator
	Clock       Clock
	LeaseTTL    time.Duration
	MaxAttempts int
}

func (processor Processor) ProcessNext(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if processor.Flows == nil || processor.Students == nil || processor.TZ == nil || processor.IDs == nil ||
		processor.Clock == nil || processor.LeaseTTL <= 0 || processor.MaxAttempts < 1 {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	now := processor.now()
	flow, err := processor.Flows.ClaimNextProjectAuthoringFlow(ctx, processor.IDs.NewID(), now, now.Add(processor.LeaseTTL))
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if flow.Status == domain.ProjectAuthoringReady && flow.PublicationRequestedAt != nil {
		err = processor.publish(ctx, flow)
	} else if flow.Status == domain.ProjectAuthoringAuthoring {
		err = processor.author(ctx, flow)
	} else {
		err = fmt.Errorf("%w: unclaimable project authoring state", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return true, err
}

func (processor Processor) author(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) error {
	if err := processor.renew(ctx, flow); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := processor.validateOwner(ctx, flow); err != nil {
		return processor.handleOwnerError(ctx, flow, err)
	}
	if err := processor.renew(ctx, flow); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	job, err := processor.loadOrCreateTZJob(ctx, flow)
	if err != nil {
		return processor.handleTZError(ctx, flow, err)
	}
	if flow.TZAuthoringJobID == "" {
		flow, err = processor.Flows.CheckpointTZAuthoringJob(
			ctx, flow, flow.ClaimToken, job.ID, job.Status, processor.now(),
		)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err := validateTZJobForFlow(job, flow); err != nil {
		return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZInvalid)
	}
	if job.Publication != nil {
		return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZInvalid)
	}
	switch job.Status {
	case domain.TZAuthoringReady, domain.TZAuthoringStaged:
		if err := processor.validateOwner(ctx, flow); err != nil {
			return processor.handleOwnerError(ctx, flow, err)
		}
		return processor.stageReady(ctx, flow, job)
	case domain.TZAuthoringFailed:
		return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZFailed)
	case domain.TZAuthoringPlanned, domain.TZAuthoringGenerating, domain.TZAuthoringVerifying:
		if err := processor.renew(ctx, flow); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		job, err = processor.TZ.ResumeAuthoringJob(ctx, job.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return processor.handleTZError(ctx, flow, err)
		}
		if err := validateTZJobForFlow(job, flow); err != nil {
			return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZInvalid)
		}
		if job.Publication != nil {
			return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZInvalid)
		}
		if job.Status == domain.TZAuthoringReady || job.Status == domain.TZAuthoringStaged {
			if err := processor.validateOwner(ctx, flow); err != nil {
				return processor.handleOwnerError(ctx, flow, err)
			}
			return processor.stageReady(ctx, flow, job)
		}
		if job.Status == domain.TZAuthoringFailed {
			return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZFailed)
		}
		return processor.retry(ctx, flow)
	default:
		return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZInvalid)
	}
}

func (processor Processor) publish(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) error {
	// No Practice acceptance/publication proof is implemented in this owner.
	// A legacy pending publication must never submit or publish a candidate.
	return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZInvalid)
}

func (processor Processor) stageReady(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, job domain.TZAuthoringJob) error {
	verified := job
	if job.Status == domain.TZAuthoringReady {
		if err := processor.renew(ctx, flow); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var err error
		job, err = processor.TZ.StageAuthoringJob(ctx, job.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return processor.handleTZError(ctx, flow, err)
		}
	}
	if validateTZJobForFlow(job, flow) != nil || job.Status != domain.TZAuthoringStaged || job.Staging == nil ||
		job.ID != verified.ID || job.BlueprintDigest != verified.BlueprintDigest || job.CandidateDigest != verified.CandidateDigest ||
		job.ContractDigest != verified.ContractDigest || job.CapabilitiesDigest != verified.CapabilitiesDigest || job.VerificationDigest != verified.VerificationDigest {
		return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZInvalid)
	}
	if err := processor.validateOwner(ctx, flow); err != nil {
		return processor.handleOwnerError(ctx, flow, err)
	}
	return processor.Flows.MarkProjectAuthoringStaged(ctx, flow, flow.ClaimToken, job, processor.now())
}

func (processor Processor) loadOrCreateTZJob(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error) {
	if flow.TZAuthoringJobID == "" {
		return processor.TZ.EnsureAuthoringJob(ctx, flow.ID, flow.AuthoringRequest)
	}
	job, err := processor.TZ.GetAuthoringJob(ctx, flow.TZAuthoringJobID)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return job, err
	}
	// A checkpointed locator returning 404 is recovered only by replaying the
	// exact create command. TZ owns the idempotency receipt and must return the
	// same authoring job identity; Planner never invents a replacement.
	job, err = processor.TZ.EnsureAuthoringJob(ctx, flow.ID, flow.AuthoringRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, err
	}
	if job.ID != flow.TZAuthoringJobID {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return job, nil
}

func (processor Processor) validateOwner(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) error {
	profile, err := processor.Students.GetPlanningProfile(ctx, flow.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	path, err := processor.Students.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, flow.StudentID, flow.LearningPathID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return domain.ValidateProjectOwnerSnapshot(flow, profile, path)
}

func (processor Processor) renew(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) error {
	now := processor.now()
	return processor.Flows.RenewProjectAuthoringClaim(
		ctx, flow.ID, flow.ClaimToken, flow.Version, now, now.Add(processor.LeaseTTL),
	)
}

func (processor Processor) handleOwnerError(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, err error) error {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureOwnerStale)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid):
		return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureOwnerInvalid)
	default:
		return processor.retry(ctx, flow)
	}
}

func (processor Processor) handleTZError(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, err error) error {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid):
		return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureTZInvalid)
	default:
		return processor.retry(ctx, flow)
	}
}

func (processor Processor) retry(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) error {
	if flow.Attempts >= processor.MaxAttempts {
		return processor.fail(ctx, flow, domain.ProjectAuthoringFailureAttempts)
	}
	now := processor.now()
	delay := time.Second << min(flow.Attempts-1, 6)
	if err := processor.Flows.RetryProjectAuthoring(ctx, flow, flow.ClaimToken, now.Add(delay), now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (processor Processor) fail(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, code string) error {
	return processor.Flows.FailProjectAuthoring(ctx, flow, flow.ClaimToken, code, processor.now())
}

func (processor Processor) now() time.Time {
	return processor.Clock.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
}

func validateTZJobForFlow(job domain.TZAuthoringJob, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) error {
	if domain.ValidateTZAuthoringJob(job) != nil || (flow.TZAuthoringJobID != "" && job.ID != flow.TZAuthoringJobID) ||
		job.Intent != flow.AuthoringRequest.Orchestration {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if flow.ReadyAt != nil && (job.BlueprintDigest != flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest ||
		job.CandidateDigest != flow.ReadyCandidateDigest || job.ContractDigest != flow.ReadyContractDigest ||
		job.CapabilitiesDigest != flow.ReadyCapabilitiesDigest || job.VerificationDigest != flow.ReadyVerificationDigest) {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if job.Publication != nil && domain.ValidateProjectPublicationReceipt(*job.Publication, flow) != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
